lines.text: A punch comes. You turn your head.
Now you can't see the next one.
The first one makes you look away.
Canelo Álvarez is famous for his head movement.
He moves his head inches, just off the line of the punch.
Just enough to miss. Close enough to counter.
Keeping your eyes open is a reflex you can build, the app I'm building has a reaction drill for exactly this, and here's the rule.
Watch his chest, not his gloves.
Bend your knees to slip. Don't turn away.
Small move. Eyes open. Punch back.
